source.title: Shirt on a hanger (Clothing Rail and Wardrobe)
source.author: 3D Assets
source.metadataSource: 3DAssets.dev listing; AI used, contributor-reported model Claude Opus 5

inspection.observed: Front/back/oblique show off-white long-sleeved shirt on a shaped hanger; blue cuffs and a narrow blue front placket; rear shell is plain and nearly planar.
inspection.collar: Listing identifies a stand collar; captures show a narrow band only, no two turned collar leaves. Fails collar stand + leaves requirement.
inspection.placketAndButtons: Listing states five modelled buttons and buttoned placket; visible placket is a simple narrow strip with minimal button detail.
inspection.cuffs: Blue cuff bands visible at both sleeve ends.
inspection.openings: Hanger and shirt are a single display composition; captures do not prove natural open body/cuff shell edges after removing hanger.
inspection.drape: Static 1,364-triangle geometry on hanger; no cloth simulation per listing; visible body is straight/flat with negligible garment folds.
inspection.reason: The collar is a stand band without visible turned leaves, hanger display is built into the composition, and static shell does not show the natural volume/folds required by invisible-body-v1.
